label: Blend steps
intent: The in-between step is generated from the circle. Light: the middle step slides back into the circle, turning round as it goes, the circle gulps it and kicks it back out, and it travels along the blend to its place, changing shape on the way, overshoots toward the square and settles. Strong: the circle kicks harder, the step flies further toward the square and swings back to its place in two decaying beats. The square never moves.

intermediate.//: a morph between its own shape (0) and the circle (1): the step is literally the blend; values below 0 carry it on toward the square
